The post Trade futures without the wallet-hopping: Unified Wallet is now available in the EEA appeared first on Kraken Blog.

]]>

TL;DR

  • Unified Wallet is now available to EEA clients on Kraken Pro
  • It combines your spot, margin, and futures balances into one shared source of collateral, so you can trade futures without moving funds between wallets
  • Eligible holdings, including gold (XAU), count toward your futures margin automatically, with no idle collateral
  • Enabling it is a self-serve switch in your account settings, and you can do it anytime

If you already hold spot, margin, or Earn balances with us but haven’t traded futures yet, the biggest hurdle is often practical rather than strategic. Your capital sits in one wallet, your futures trades need collateral in another, and every idea starts with moving funds around. Unified Wallet takes that step out.

We’re bringing it to EEA clients on Kraken Pro, so the balances you already hold can back your futures positions directly.

What is Unified Wallet?

Enabling Unified Wallet brings your spot, margin, Earn, and futures balances together into one smart, flexible wallet. Instead of keeping capital in separate buckets, your eligible assets work as shared collateral across your positions, with margin calculated at the account level. The result is more buying power, fewer transfers, and less idle capital on every trade.

More than 40 cryptocurrencies, along with USD, EUR, and XAU, can serve as collateral. Each asset counts toward your margin at a collateral value ratio that reflects its liquidity, and those ratios can change with market conditions.

What changes when you enable it

  • No manual transfers. Your eligible balances are already available as margin, so you can open a futures position without funding a separate futures wallet first
  • Shared collateral. Assets across your spot, margin, earn, and futures balances back your positions, so capital is never stuck in a wallet your trade can’t use
  • Unrealized P&L that works for you. Unrealized profit and loss on your margin and futures positions can count as margin for other trades, which boosts your capital efficiency
  • Two margin modes. Cross margin is the default, and isolated margin remains available for linear Multi-M futures contracts when you want to limit what a single position can use

See your commodities work harder

Say you hold gold (XAU) in your Unified Wallet. It automatically counts toward your futures margin, with no transfers and no idle collateral. From there, you can trade BTC or ETH futures using the gold you already hold.

The same logic applies across your account. The assets you hold for spot, margin, or earn can now back your futures positions without any extra funding.

Is Unified Wallet right for you?

Unified Wallet is built for capital efficiency, and that comes with a trade-off worth understanding. With separate wallets, a loss on a futures position can’t touch your spot holdings. With Unified Wallet in cross margin mode, a losing position can draw on your entire eligible balance.

Unified Wallet with cross margin may be better if you:

  • Actively trade across spot, margin, and futures
  • Understand margin, maintenance margin, and liquidation
  • Want to maximize capital efficiency
  • Are comfortable with your full eligible balance serving as collateral for your positions

Separate wallets or isolated margin may be better if you:

  • Are new to leveraged trading
  • Hold long-term assets you don’t want exposed to futures losses
  • Want to know exactly how much is exposed in each product
  • Want to cap the maximum loss on each trade

You’re always in control. You can switch back to separate wallets whenever you like, as long as you have no open derivatives positions or active orders.

How to enable Unified Wallet

You don’t need to close any open positions to switch. Once you enable Unified Wallet, your eligible balances are pooled immediately. If you haven’t activated futures trading on Kraken Pro yet, you can do that in your account settings first.

On Kraken Pro web:

  1. Click your profile icon in the top right, then click Settings
  2. Under Trading platform, click Edit, then select Unified Wallet

On the Kraken Pro app:

  1. Tap More at the bottom right
  2. Tap your name at the top of the page
  3. Tap Preferences
  4. Tap the Wallet setting dropdown at the top of the page (it will show Separate if you haven’t switched yet)
  5. Tap Unified Wallet, then tap Confirm

For a full breakdown of margin modes, collateral values, and liquidation, read our Introduction to Unified Wallet support article.

Put your collateral to work

Unified Wallet is now available to EEA clients. One wallet, every asset, working together.

TL;DR

  • Enroll in the $5,000,000 USDG Kraken Futures Challenge. It runs from October 12 to December 10, 2026 on Kraken Futures.
  • Traders are ranked by Weighted Trading Volume, not profit, with a 3x multiplier on gold, 2x on real-world assets (RWAs), and 1x on crypto futures.
  • The reward pool grows through eight tiers as Community Volume rises, reaching up to $5,000,000 USDG at $18.5 billion of weighted Community Volume. The final pool depends on total participant volume and isn’t guaranteed.
  • Open to eligible clients where Kraken Futures is available, excluding the US, UK, EEA, Switzerland, Canada, and Australia.

Gold, crude oil, the euro, Nvidia, and Bitcoin don’t usually share a leaderboard. For 60 days on Kraken Futures, they do.

First, enroll in the competition. Then, from October 12 to December 10, 2026, the $5,000,000 USDG Kraken Futures Challenge ranks every enrolled trader on a single leaderboard by Weighted Trading Volume. Gold counts triple, RWAs count double, and crypto counts once. Profit and loss doesn’t factor in.

The reward pool isn’t fixed. It starts at the Default tier and steps up as the community’s combined volume crosses each threshold, reaching up to $5,000,000 USDG at the top. The final size of the pool depends on the total trading volume of all participants and isn’t guaranteed.

Eligible markets and multipliers

Every futures contract available to you on Kraken Futures counts toward the Challenge. What changes is how much each one counts:

  • Gold (3x): the Gold 24/7 perp (PF_XAUUSD)
  • Real-world assets (2x): commodities (Brent crude, WTI crude, natural gas, silver, and copper), forex (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, and CHF/USD), equity perps (Micron, Intel, Nebius, Samsung, SK Hynix, SanDisk, SOXL, and SOXS), xStocks perps (AAPLx, AMZNx, COINx, CRCLx, GLDx, GOOGLx, HOODx, METAx, MSTRx, NVDAx, QQQx, SPCXx, SPYx, and TSLAx), and the US100 index perp
  • Crypto (1x): all other perpetual and fixed-maturity futures on Kraken Futures

In practice, $10,000 of gold volume adds $30,000 to your Weighted Trading Volume, $10,000 in an RWA perp adds $20,000, and $10,000 in a crypto perp adds $10,000.

The full list of eligible instruments is in the terms and conditions. We may add or remove instruments during the Challenge, for example when a contract is listed, delisted, or expires. Any change will be posted on the Challenge page and applies only to trades placed after it’s posted.

How the competition works

  • Enroll first, then trade eligible futures between 12:00 a.m. UTC on October 12, 2026, and 11:59:59 p.m. UTC on December 10, 2026
  • Your Trading Volume is the USD notional value of your filled orders on eligible instruments, including opening and closing trades, and both maker and taker orders
  • Each instrument’s multiplier turns your Trading Volume into Weighted Trading Volume, which sets your rank. Profit and loss isn’t considered
  • You need at least $50,000 in Weighted Trading Volume to be ranked and eligible for a reward
  • The live leaderboard shows a pseudonymous identifier, your rank, and your Weighted Trading Volume. It’s indicative only, and final rankings are verified after the Challenge ends

The reward pool

When the Challenge ends, the reward pool is set by the highest tier that the combined Weighted Trading Volume of every trader who meets the minimum has reached. Every enrolled trader’s volume counts toward it, so the whole leaderboard moves up together.

At Tier 4 ($6 billion), the pool reaches $1,000,000 USDG and the Tail Pool, which shares rewards among every qualifying trader ranked 51st or lower, grows to $405,000. At Tier 7 ($18.5 billion), the pool reaches $5,000,000 USDG. All rewards are paid in USDG, and Community Volume is shown in weighted USD.

Default to Tier 3

Tier 4 to Tier 7

Rewards aren’t cumulative across tiers: each winner receives only the reward for the final tier reached. If fewer traders qualify than there are rewards available, unallocated rewards aren’t distributed.

How to enter

You must enroll before you trade, and trades placed before you enroll don’t count.

  1. Enroll in the Challenge. Log in to your Kraken account (or create one) with access to Kraken Futures, then select Join the Challenge on the Challenge page.
  2. Trade eligible futures between 12:00 a.m. UTC on October 12, 2026, and 11:59:59 p.m. UTC on December 10, 2026.
  3. Complete Intermediate verification before the Challenge ends. You’ll need an account in good standing with at least Intermediate verification to receive a reward.
Enroll in the Challenge

The Challenge is subject to the terms and conditions. The Challenge is open to eligible clients aged 18 or older (or the age of majority in your jurisdiction, if higher) in jurisdictions where Kraken Futures is available, excluding the US, UK, EEA, Switzerland, Canada, and Australia. Additional regional restrictions may apply. Each person can participate with one Kraken account only.

Market makers and liquidity providers, managed accounts (including accounts traded through copy-trading or signal services), and our employees, contractors, and directors aren’t eligible.

The Challenge rewards genuine trading activity. Wash trading, self-matching, coordinated trading between accounts, offsetting positions built to generate volume without real market exposure, and other manipulative activity are prohibited. Ordinary API trading is permitted. We monitor trading activity throughout the Challenge and may exclude volume, adjust rankings, disqualify participants, or reclaim rewards, including after they’ve been credited.

We’re thrilled to announce that ZCHF is available for trading on Kraken!

Funding and trading

ZCHF trading is live as of October 8, 2026.

To add an asset to your Kraken account, navigate to Funding, select the asset you’re after, and hit ‘Deposit’. 

Make sure to deposit your tokens into networks supported by Kraken. Deposits made using other networks will be lost.

Trade ZCHF on Kraken

Here’s some more information about this asset:

Frankencoin (ZCHF)

Frankencoin (ZCHF) is a decentralized, over-collateralized stablecoin that tracks the value of the Swiss franc. Rather than holding fiat reserves with a custodian, ZCHF is created when users deposit approved crypto collateral into on-chain positions and mint against it, and burned when those positions are repaid. Each unit in circulation is backed by on-chain collateral worth at least one Swiss franc.

Borrowers pay a fixed rate of interest upfront for a term they select, which makes minting function as an on-chain lombard loan denominated in Swiss francs. Holders can deposit ZCHF into the protocol’s savings module, an ERC-4626 vault paying a variable rate funded by borrower fees and set through governance. ZCHF launched on Ethereum mainnet in 2023 as an ERC-20 token and is also deployed on Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Gnosis, Optimism, Polygon and Sonic through a Chainlink CCIP bridge.

Please note:  

  • Trading via Kraken App and Instant Buy will be available once the liquidity conditions are met (when a sufficient number of buyers and sellers have entered the market for their orders to be efficiently matched).
